To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the proposed methodology can be used for Web service design/redesign of a business process and that a Web services portfolio should be designed to achieve a balance among different business objectives.
the Web service-based business processes design methodology is an appropriate and effective way to design/redesign the business processes and the business networks.

(1) Web services provide a flexible and agile IT architecture for enterprises to respond to dynamic business environment and to design/redesign their business processes; (2) the framework and methodology proposed in this research provide a comprehensive and formal model to evaluate and select alternative Web services portfolio for business processes; and (3) Web services are not a panacea for business processes, but they are one of the most promising IT technologies for business processes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design/redesign of Web services in business processes.
the following issues: (1) How can Web services be used in business processes and business network design?
the development of a formal framework for designing/redesigning business processes using Web services.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Web services portfolio is an effective and powerful approach for designing/redesigning business processes.
the Web services are an emerging technology which can be utilized in business processes and business network design and re-design.
the proposed framework and methodology can help firms to identify, evaluate, and implement Web services portfolio for business processes and business network design/redesign.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a methodology to identify and evaluate the optimal Web services portfolio for a business process.
we have developed a framework and methodology for the design/redesign of e-services with Web services.

we have developed a formal framework for designing/redesigning business processes using Web services and we have demonstrated that the proposed framework and methodology are effective for the purpose of business processes design/redesign with Web services.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Web services provide a technological basis for the design of business processes.
the Web Services Portfolio Model (WSPM) is a useful tool to evaluate and design/redesign business process with Web Services.
Web services can provide a new way to design/redesign of the business process, which can be used to achieve the business objectives and goals.
